declared_purpose: Organize user-provided migration survey materials into a Chinese .docx report covering customer profile, current architecture, Alibaba Cloud product mappings, compatibility risks, migration risks and unresolved questions. Actual migration and pricing are excluded. Extraction, JSON staging, report generation and quality checking are explicit requirements.

data_operations.operation: Validate and read survey files locally
data_operations.data_scope: All nonempty Excel rows across sheets; Word paragraphs and tables; complete text; CSV headers and rows. File existence, size and resolved path are also inspected.
data_operations.condition: The CLI checks dependencies, rejects traversal patterns and unsupported extensions, and reads existing nonempty files up to 100 MB. No content minimization occurs during extraction.

data_operations.operation: Return extracted content or CLI summaries
data_operations.data_scope: Imported extraction functions return complete extracted structures or text. The mandatory CLI path prints only sheet names and counts, paragraph/table counts, text length or CSV statistics.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Importing caller or CLI stdout; a normal return does not establish remote disclosure
data_operations.condition: Depends on invocation path. The CLI does not serialize extracted content for the agent assembling survey_data.

data_operations.operation: Select survey facts and infer migration attributes
data_operations.source: Survey materials and packaged mapping/risk references
data_operations.data_scope: Customer and business profile, architecture, versions, security requirements, domain information, inferred source cloud, target mappings and compatibility risk levels
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Agent-assembled survey_data and subsequently the report
data_operations.condition: Required by the entry document. Source cloud may be inferred from product or region clues; risk levels are derived from version rules. The generator renders supplied assessments rather than computing them.

data_operations.operation: Stage structured survey data and read it locally
data_operations.data_scope: Structured survey facts and assessments; json.load reads the entire supplied JSON
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Required survey_data_json_file on disk, then generate_report.py memory
data_operations.condition: JSON persistence is explicitly mandatory. The generator validates the JSON path, extension and 50 MB size limit before loading. No intermediate-file cleanup is specified.

data_operations.operation: Persist and reread reconstructed input in the missing-file fallback
data_operations.source: Survey information already provided in the conversation, serialized into details_json
data_operations.data_scope: Provided titles, paragraphs, headers, rows or text; unspecified facts must remain placeholders
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local details_json; reconstructed source at the referenced path; subsequent extract.py memory
data_operations.condition: The contract requires an initial failed extraction and usable conversation information. Traversal paths must not be reconstructed. The helper guards the destination but reads its details JSON without equivalent path validation; it contains no existing-file refusal or cleanup.

data_operations.data_scope: Customer identity, business requirements, architecture, security/domain fields, mappings, strategies, risks and next steps. Customer identity also appears on the cover, footer and filename.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Validated output_dir, default ./output/, as {safe_name}_迁移调研分析报告.docx
data_operations.condition: Report generation is mandatory. Filename sanitization removes unsafe characters rather than anonymizing identity. Existing output is overwritten after a warning. Saving precedes quality checking; generate_report() itself returns only the local path.

data_operations.operation: Inspect the saved report and infer sensitive-data matches
data_operations.data_scope: Body paragraphs and table cells; section/table statistics, completeness, pricing terms and regex-based credential/IP/private-key/JWT matches
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local quality_check memory and returned results
data_operations.condition: Quality checking is mandatory and automatic in the generator CLI. Headers and footers are outside the collected full_text. Private and example IPv4 ranges are ignored. Sensitive matches produce warnings without failing, redacting or deleting the report.

data_operations.source: Input/output paths, workbook metadata, survey identity and quality-check findings
data_operations.data_scope: Resolved paths, file sizes, sheet names, customer/project names, counts and up to three matched public IPv4 addresses per check
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Python logging stream, default stderr, and CLI stdout; no packaged log-file sink is configured
data_operations.condition: Successful validation, extraction, generation, overwrite or quality checking can emit diagnostics. Sensitive warnings are returned to callers and logged; external capture or persistence is unspecified.

data_operations.source: Locally installed openpyxl and docx modules
data_operations.condition: The extraction CLI checks dependencies. Installation is assigned to build time; runtime downloads are explicitly forbidden. The entry document declares no external MCP calls.

potential_excess.data_scope: Credentials, tokens, real IP addresses or other sensitive values embedded in supported survey_data text fields
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Saved report under output_dir, including files remaining after failed quality checks
potential_excess.condition: Sensitive values reach rendered fields. The generator writes them without masking, saves before checking and treats sensitive matches as nonblocking warnings; private IPv4 addresses are whitelisted.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The report is required, but the entry document explicitly prohibits customer-sensitive data in it. This concerns extra data within a required artifact.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retain customer profile, architecture relationships, security requirements and migration assessments.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Redact credentials and replace sensitive addresses with stable aliases before saving; make unresolved sensitive findings block delivery and remove or replace unsafe generated artifacts.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve meaningful topology, component versions and risk explanations; retain mandatory generation and quality checking.

potential_excess.data_scope: Up to three literal matched public IPv4 addresses
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: quality_check results['warnings'] and the Python logging stream
potential_excess.condition: detect_sensitive_data finds non-whitelisted IPv4 addresses in report body text or tables.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Sensitive-information checking is mandatory; reproducing addresses in its diagnostics is an implementation choice. The excess is warning content, not the check itself.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Tell the caller which sensitive-data category was detected and support correction.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Return category, count and a non-sensitive field or section reference instead of address values.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep detection coverage and actionable warnings without echoing matched sensitive content.

potential_excess.data_scope: Customer/project names, absolute filesystem paths and workbook sheet names
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Operational logging stream and extraction CLI stdout, separate from the required report
potential_excess.condition: Normal validation, workbook extraction, report generation or save/overwrite diagnostics run.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: These identifiers support the report or local file operation, but routine diagnostic reproduction is not an explicit reporting requirement.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Provide progress, counts and actionable file-operation errors.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use task-local references, sheet indexes and minimal path information in routine logs; return the actual deliverable path only where needed.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep enough information to distinguish inputs and locate the generated report. Do not assume the logging stream is remotely disclosed or persistently stored.

potential_excess.data_scope: Workflow-created survey_data JSON and fallback details JSON
potential_excess.condition: These intermediate copies are retained after their required consumers finish. Persistence is required, but no cleanup or retention period is specified.
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Staging and fallback reconstruction are explicit requirements; continued retention of intermediate copies is not. Their creation should not be classified as redundant.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Write the required JSON, run its consumer and complete extraction, generation and quality checking.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Limit intermediate fields to their consumer's needs and delete workflow-owned staging copies after their last required use, subject to a defined retry policy.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve user-owned inputs, requested reconstructed files and final deliverables; retain intermediates while necessary for recovery.

unknowns: End-to-end content handoff is unresolved: the mandatory extraction CLI emits summaries, not extracted content. The package does not show how the assembling agent obtains that content while obeying the prescribed sequence.
Actual input contents and agent-side field selection or redaction are unavailable. Sensitive-report findings are conditional, not evidence of an actual customer-data leak.

QoderWork/model transport, tool-output capture, report delivery, external recipients and host retention are unspecified. No first-party network disclosure is shown; Alibaba Cloud product references and migration-tool recommendations do not establish transfers.
Dependency implementations are not supplied. Their undocumented behavior cannot be determined from version pins or imports.
Agent-side cleanup and host storage lifetimes are unspecified. The packaged scripts show no automatic deletion of intermediate files or reports that fail checking.
